driver_archetypes.rationale: Standard compliant car behavior to match M1/car discharge headway and ensure correct lane positioning.
Higher impatience allows occasional early starts (M2/early/car) to increase the simulated share from 0.003 to target ~0.007.
Lower tau and tight gaps increase flow to reduce discharge headway (M1/moto) from 0.42s towards target 0.25s.
Higher tau and center alignment mimic slow riders who overshoot the stop line (M4/overshoot_share) and increase M4/lat_moto.
Custom1 base class enables queue_space_seeking to ride in lane 0 (wrong lane) to bypass queues (M8/moto wrong-lane share).
High tau/minGap and long red-drive time ensure illegal left-turners wait in the box until opposing green ends (M6/approach/l/moto, M7a/n_waiting).

traci_rules.rationale: Increased probability (0.18) targets M2/early/car (0.0074); applies to passenger archetypes.
Increased probability for motorcycles to creep before green targets M2/early/moto (0.1303).
Higher base probability (0.55) and swarm effect simulate group red-running to target M3/share/moto (0.09048).
Force usage of adjacent lane (lane 0) to bypass queues when queue length > 50m targets M8/moto wrong-lane share (0.2131).
Small release lag ensures exit shortly after opposing green ends, targeting M7a/release_time (0.28s) and reducing excessive box occupancy.
Targets M4/lat_moto (7.1m); lat_offset 0 keeps the slow motorcycle in the lane center to minimize overshoot.
High probability reflects that motorcycles frequently squeeze past standing U-turners to reduce M9b/delay_blocked.
